6435.title: CLI override re-entry never reaches the bundled command
6435.rootCauseOneLine: The bb-app CLI entry repeatedly spawns BB_CLI without checking or setting the existing re-exec guard; when BB_CLI resolves to its launcher, every child enters the same path again.

prReviews.topFinding: Sets and checks the re-exec guard at the launcher boundary; PR code was not executed.

6435.proposedFix: Bound launcher override delegation with the existing re-exec guard; the already-open PR #6436 covers this issue, so no duplicate fix was opened.
6435.caveats: Recursion was bounded at four entries. OOM and the live scheduler were not exercised; no fixed-branch pass is claimed. Reproduction programs and test are embedded inline.
